titles.title: Hand Over the Money! Underworld Capital

description:
The underworld has become a capitalist society.

One must settle their debts, even in death.

“Wait, you’re saying I can’t move on to the afterlife until I settle my debt?”

Cheon Jae-hak died drowning in debt. That news hit him like a ton of bricks right after dying!

Jae-hak, with his taekwondo skills, will join Underworld Capital to collect money from wandering spirits.

From a debtor to the youngest member of a financial firm!

Alright, I’ll earn money and pay off my debt!

A crazy, overpowered occultist who’ll pay off his debt by beating up ghosts!?

Hey, this actually pays pretty well!
